page.overview:
Who is Olivia?

Olivia is cheerful and informal whenever she contacts Lars, though it is clear she also respects him and is loyal to him. She rarely seems to take credit, although Lars praises and appreciates her work. She is used to military situations and seems unfazed by them, and is easily able to offer Lars timely warnings when he is in danger.

Olivia appears to be a young woman, possibly in her twenties. She is Caucasian and has short red/ginger hair, her eyes appear to be light in color, and may be blue.

In the Pachislot 4′s Yggdrasil story, Olivia contacts Lars by radio a number of times throughout the mission, and supplies him with information he needs to keep on top of the Mishima Zaibatsu's operations. She frequently warns him of incoming G-Corp and Mishima Zaibatsu enemies who are approaching him. Although she does not make a physical appearance in the game, she is pictured whenever she is on the radio.
